title: The Idaten Deities Know Only Peace
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Eight hundred years after the Idaten deities sealed away the demons, the foul-mouthed young deity Hayato and his idle generation of gods must defend humanity when the seal breaks, though they know nothing of war (Seven Seas blurb via AniList, MangaUpdates and Penguin Random House). It is a seinen action series based on Amahara's webcomic, published by Seven Seas. Database tags list sexual violence, nudity, slavery and human experimentation.
life_message: Unclear from sources; database tags suggest the gods meet cruelty with ruthless force.
